findings.text: follow-on: the predicate drops every .r-comment element whose id HEAD does not carry, on the premise that only the plan store writes comments/promotion records, and _collapse_inter_tag removes whitespace between any two adjacent tags. Both are the intended tolerance for store-owned writes, but a genuinely foreign comment element, or an authored edit consisting only of whitespace between tags, would be tolerated rather than refused. Low risk because comments are a store artifact and the store is the sole writer; named so the boundary is on record.

justifications.durability: the new comparison is guarded by four executable cases, including the cascade that a refusal strands nothing for the next promotion and the canonical-encoding tolerance; I verified both directions of the guard are load-bearing. The remaining exposure is that the tolerance line rides the store writer's round-trip: a future change to _plan_html.write_state that moves what it normalises could narrow the comparison silently, and only tests 1 and 4 would redden. The evidence fragment is a standalone HTML fragment with no reader in the tree until a coordinator folds it into the plan section, which is the usual post-promotion step.
justifications.evidence: independently reproduced at the reviewed head: tests/test_landing_commit_carries_only_its_own_comment.py runs 4 passed (my own run, EXIT=0). I falsified the guard in both directions on a scratch copy of the head: forcing _plan_differs_only_by_the_stores_own_writes to return False fails the two tolerance cases (test_a_re_promotion_commits_a_plan_differing_only_by_its_own_comment, test_a_plan_stored_before_the_writers_canonical_encoding_lands; 2 failed, EXIT=1) and forcing it to return True fails the two refusal cases (test_an_unrelated_edit_to_the_plan_refuses_before_committing, test_a_refused_landing_strands_nothing_for_the_next_promotion; 2 failed, EXIT=1), so the new code path, not a passing suite, is what each case exercises. The regression story resolves: 4e2c05ce7 is an ancestor of base e70bb91cb, whose subject is Revert of the merge, and base's promotion.py carries no guard. The manifest's baseline_suite (52 passed, EXIT=0) and after_suite (56 passed, EXIT=0) gate logs read; added_failure_count is 0 with no ids.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's own idioms: a private predicate beside _path_differs_from_head, a narrow refusal helper, and _plan_html/_store reuse rather than a second writer. Names are mechanism-named (no plan, sprint or ticket labels), the test module keeps its fixture-synthesis shape and asserts the real stores are untouched, and the refusal message names the plan file and the reason. Lint adds no findings. No versioned or _new/_v2 names are introduced.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node re-lands the landing guard the plan section needs: promotion refuses only an unrelated plan edit, not the store's own writes. The earlier byte-comparison guard (4e2c05ce7) was reverted at the reviewed base e70bb91cb because it refused the store's own re-encoding, moved stamps and an earlier run's recorded comment; _plan_differs_only_by_the_stores_own_writes now compares rendered-parsed state (disk comments whose id HEAD lacks dropped, both version stamps stripped, inter-tag whitespace collapsed), and _refuse_unrelated_plan_* runs in _complete_locked before either store is written. Both clauses of the goal are met and covered by a case: tolerance (tests 1 and 4) and refusal-before-write (tests 2 and 3).
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch exactly three paths, all inside the node's declared write paths: reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_landing_commit_carries_only_its_own_comment.py and the evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner/landing-guard-tolerates-the-stores-own-writes.html. No plan, sprint or index state is mutated; the covered paths are exactly base..head with nothing else. The tests synthesise their own repository and RECKON_HOME and assert the real checkout's plan and state directories are untouched.
